title: Bebenworld
wikitext:
[[Bebenworld]] was one of the first Quakeworld-only lanparties in Germany. It was held in a village near Erfurt from 2000.06.16 to 2000.06.18 by members of the Beben Lanparty crew. Almost 50 players from all over germany attended.

A sequel was planned for April 2004, but was canceled due to lack of interest.
